Title: Register with valid data
Preconditions: On signup page; email and username not used before
Steps:
1. Fill all fields with valid data
2. Click Sign up
Test data:
Username: qa_tester1
Email: qa.tester1@test.com
Password: Test@1234
Expected result: Redirected to login page; new user exists in users table (SQL check Q1)
Actual result: As expected.

Title: Submit with all fields empty
Steps:
1. Leave all fields empty
2. Click Sign up
Expected result: Form not submitted; 'is required' error shown under each of the 4 fields
Actual result: As expected.

Title: Username shorter than minimum (2 chars)
Steps:
1. Enter 2-character username, other fields valid
2. Click Sign up
Expected result: Form not submitted; error says username must be at least 3 characters
Actual result: As expected.

Title: Username at minimum length (3 chars)
Steps:
1. Enter 3-character username, other fields valid
2. Click Sign up
Expected result: Username accepted; account created
Actual result: As expected.

Title: Username at maximum length (15 chars)
Steps:
1. Enter 15-character username, other fields valid
2. Click Sign up
Expected result: Username accepted; account created
Actual result: As expected.

Title: Username over maximum length (16 chars)
Steps:
1. Enter 16-character username
2. Read the error message
Expected result: Form not submitted; error message correctly states the allowed maximum (15 characters)
Actual result: Form not submitted, but the error says 'Username must be less than 15 characters' although 15 characters is allowed (SU-05). Message suggests a maximum of 14.

Title: Invalid email formats
Steps:
1. Enter each invalid email, other fields valid
2. Click Sign up after each
Expected result: Each one rejected with 'Email is not valid'
Actual result: As expected.

Title: Password shorter than 8 characters
Steps:
1. Enter 7-char password meeting all other rules
2. Click Sign up
Expected result: Form not submitted; 'At least 8 characters' rule stays unchecked
Actual result: As expected.

Title: Password at minimum length (8 chars)
Steps:
1. Enter 8-char password meeting all rules
2. Click Sign up
Expected result: Password accepted; account created
Actual result: As expected.

Title: Password missing one required character type
Steps:
1. Enter each password
2. Watch the rules checklist
3. Click Sign up
Test data:
test@1234 (no uppercase)
TEST@1234 (no lowercase)
Test@abcd (no number)
Test12345 (no symbol)
Expected result: Each rejected; the matching rule stays unchecked in the checklist
Actual result: As expected.

Title: Password rules checklist updates live
Steps:
1. Click into Password
2. Type T, e, @, 1... one character at a time
Expected result: Checklist appears on focus; each rule turns green as soon as it is met; hides on blur
Actual result: As expected.

Title: Confirm password does not match
Steps:
1. Enter valid password
2. Enter different confirm password
3. Click Sign up
Expected result: Form not submitted; 'Passwords do not match' shown
Actual result: As expected.

Title: Register with an email already in use
Steps:
1. Fill form using SU-01's email and a new username
2. Click Sign up
Expected result: Account not created; clear error message shown; still only 1 user with that email (SQL check Q2)
Actual result: Account not created; still 1 user with that email. Error shown: 'Korisničko ime ili email su već u upotrebi.' (Serbian, see SU-16).

Title: Register with a username already in use
Steps:
1. Fill form using SU-01's username and a new email
2. Click Sign up
Expected result: Account not created; clear error message shown
Actual result: Account not created; same error message as SU-13.

Title: Server-side validation with JavaScript disabled
Preconditions: JavaScript disabled in browser (DevTools > Settings > Debugger)
Steps:
1. Submit signup with: weak password, 1-char username
2. Re-enable JavaScript afterwards
Expected result: Server rejects the input; no account is created with invalid data
Actual result: Server accepted the input: account created with username 'a' and password 'abc'; redirected to login page.

Title: Error messages are in one consistent language
Steps:
1. Trigger client-side errors (empty fields)
2. Trigger server-side errors (duplicate email)
3. Compare languages
Expected result: All messages use the same language as the rest of the UI
Actual result: Mixed languages: client-side errors are English ('Email is required'), server-side errors are Serbian ('Korisničko ime ili email su već u upotrebi.', 'Pogrešan email ili lozinka.').

Title: Password is stored hashed
Steps: 1. Run SQL check Q1
Expected result: Pass column holds a bcrypt hash (starts with $2y$), never the plain password
Actual result: As expected. Pass starts with $2y$, length 60.

Title: Log in with valid credentials
Steps:
1. Enter registered email and password
2. Click Log in
Expected result: Logged in and redirected to the submit recipe page
Actual result: As expected.

Title: Log in with wrong password
Steps:
1. Enter registered email, wrong password
2. Click Log in
Expected result: Stays on login page; generic error shown (does not reveal which field is wrong)
Actual result: As expected. Generic error 'Pogrešan email ili lozinka.' (Serbian, see SU-16).

Title: Log in with unregistered email
Steps:
1. Enter unregistered email and any password
2. Click Log in
Expected result: Stays on login page; same generic error as LI-02
Actual result: As expected. Same generic error as LI-02.

Title: Log in with empty fields
Steps:
1. Leave fields empty
2. Click Log in
Expected result: Form not submitted; required-field message shown
Actual result: As expected. Browser blocks submit: 'Please fill out this field.'

Title: Email is case-insensitive at login
Steps:
1. Enter email in uppercase with correct password
2. Click Log in
Expected result: Login succeeds
Actual result: As expected.

Title: Log out ends the session
Steps:
1. Click Log out
2. Open submit.php directly in the address bar
Expected result: Logged out; submit.php redirects to login page
Actual result: No Log out button or link anywhere; header still shows LOG IN / SIGN UP while logged in. Opening logout.php directly does end the session (submit.php then redirects to login).

Title: Protected page without logging in
Steps: 1. Open php/submit.php directly in the address bar
Expected result: Redirected to login page
Actual result: As expected.

Title: Back button after logout
Steps:
1. Log out
2. Press browser Back button
Expected result: Protected content is not shown or usable; any action redirects to login
Actual result: As expected. Back after logout lands on the login page.

Title: Submit a complete recipe
Steps:
1. Fill all fields, choose photo under 2 MB, pick 2 categories and 2 tags
2. Click Submit
Test data:
Title: QA Test Pancakes
Time: 30
Photo: 500 KB JPG
Expected result: Recipe saved; visible in recipes list and on its details page with all entered data (SQL check Q3)
Actual result: As expected. 'Recipe submitted successfully!'; saved with correct author, 2 categories and 2 tags; shown in list and on details page.

Title: Required fields left empty
Steps:
1. Leave Title, Time and Recipe empty
2. Click Submit
Expected result: Form not submitted; required fields highlighted
Actual result: As expected. Browser blocks submit; Title, Time and Recipe marked invalid; nothing saved.

Title: Photo larger than 2 MB
Steps: 1. Choose a JPG just over 2 MB
Expected result: Alert 'File too large (max 2MB)'; file cleared; no preview
Actual result: As expected.

Title: Photo just under 2 MB
Steps:
1. Choose a JPG just under 2 MB
2. Submit the recipe
Expected result: Photo accepted, previewed and saved with the recipe
Actual result: As expected. Preview shown; saved file is 1,992,294 bytes.

Title: Unsupported file types
Steps:
1. Try to choose a GIF
2. Try a .txt file renamed to .jpg
3. Submit
Expected result: Non-image files rejected; no broken image saved
Actual result: All three files accepted and saved: GIF, text file renamed to .jpg (saved as a broken image), and a .php file, which the server then executes when its URL is opened.

Title: Submit without a photo
Steps:
1. Fill required fields, no photo
2. Click Submit
Expected result: Recipe saved; a placeholder image shown instead of a broken image
Actual result: Recipe saved with ImageURL 'default.png', but that file doesn't exist: broken image on the details page and in the list.

Title: Invalid preparation time
Steps:
1. Enter each time value
2. Click Submit after each
Expected result: 0 and negative values rejected; unrealistic values rejected or warned
Actual result: 0 and -5 rejected by the server, but with the misleading message 'Molimo popunite sva obavezna polja...'. 99999 accepted and saved with no warning.

Title: Servings slider range and display
Steps: 1. Drag servings slider to both ends
Expected result: Range is 1–15; displayed number matches slider position
Actual result: As expected. Range 1–15; display matches.

Title: Difficulty slider range and display
Steps: 1. Drag difficulty slider to both ends
Expected result: Range is 1–5; displayed number matches slider position
Actual result: As expected. Range 1–5; display matches.

Title: Title longer than 255 characters
Steps:
1. Paste a 300-character title
2. Fill other required fields
3. Click Submit
Expected result: Input limited or clear error shown; no database error shown to the user
Actual result: No input limit. Recipe not saved and raw database error shown: 'Greška pri upisu u bazu: SQLSTATE[22001]: String data, right truncated: 1406 Data too long for column 'Title' at row 1'.

Title: HTML in text fields is shown as plain text
Steps:
1. Enter HTML in Title and Description
2. Submit
3. Open the recipe's details page and the list
Expected result: Text shown literally; no bold formatting, no alert popup
Actual result: As expected. HTML shown as plain text; no bold, no alert.

Title: Owner sees Edit and Delete on own recipe
Preconditions: Logged in as the recipe's author
Steps: 1. Open details page of own recipe
Expected result: Edit and Delete buttons visible
Actual result: As expected.

Title: Other users don't see Edit and Delete
Preconditions: Logged in as a different user (or logged out)
Steps: 1. Open details page of someone else's recipe
Expected result: Edit and Delete buttons not visible
Actual result: Logged in as another user: buttons hidden (correct). Logged out: Change and Delete visible on every recipe.

Title: Edit another user's recipe via URL
Preconditions: Logged in as a user who is NOT the author
Steps: 1. Open php/edit_recipe.php?id=<other user's recipe id>
Expected result: Access denied / redirected; edit form not shown
Actual result: Logged in as another user: 'You do not have permission to edit this recipe!' (correct). Logged out: edit form opens and saving changes another user's recipe.

Title: Edit own recipe
Steps:
1. Click Edit
2. Change title, time and one category
3. Save
Expected result: Redirected to details page showing the new values; old category removed (SQL check Q4)
Actual result: As expected. Redirected to details page; title and time updated; removed category gone.

Title: Delete asks for confirmation (Cancel)
Steps:
1. Click Delete
2. Click Cancel in the dialog
Expected result: Confirmation dialog appears; recipe is NOT deleted after Cancel
Actual result: As expected.

Title: Delete own recipe
Steps:
1. Click Delete
2. Confirm
Expected result: Recipe gone from list; details URL no longer shows it; no orphan category/tag rows (SQL check Q5)
Actual result: As expected. No orphan category or tag rows.

Title: Search by existing keyword
Steps:
1. Type a word from a recipe title into search
2. Press Enter
Expected result: Only matching recipes shown
Actual result: As expected. 'pasta' returns only Vodka Pasta.

Title: Search with no matches
Steps: 1. Search a nonsense word
Expected result: 'No recipes found' message; no errors
Actual result: As expected. 'No recipes found matching your filters.'

Title: Search is case-insensitive
Steps: 1. Search the same word in lower and upper case
Expected result: Same results for both
Actual result: As expected.

Title: Filter by time and difficulty
Steps:
1. On recipes page tick a time range
2. Select a difficulty
3. Apply
Expected result: Every shown recipe matches both filters
Actual result: As expected. 4 recipes shown, all 10–30 min and difficulty 2; matches the database.

Title: Search term kept when filtering
Steps:
1. Search a keyword
2. Then apply a filter
Expected result: Results match both the keyword and the filter; keyword still visible in search box
Actual result: Results are correct (keyword and filter both applied), but the search box is empty after filtering.

Title: Sorting options
Steps: 1. Try each option in the Sort dropdown
Expected result: List reorders correctly for each option
Actual result: As expected. Time ascending, time descending and highest rated all ordered correctly.

Title: Details page without id
Steps: 1. Open php/details.php with no ?id
Expected result: Redirected to recipes list
Actual result: As expected.

Title: Details page with non-existent or invalid id
Steps:
1. Open details.php?id=99999
2. Open details.php?id=abc
Expected result: User-friendly 'not found' page within the normal site layout; no raw errors
Actual result: Both show only the plain text 'Recipe not found.' on a blank, unstyled page with no header, footer or navigation.

Title: Submit support form with valid data
Steps:
1. Fill all support fields
2. Submit
Expected result: Confirmation shown; request saved in support table (SQL check Q6)
Actual result: Form has no backend: page just reloads with the data in the URL (?type=1&email=...); nothing saved in support table; no confirmation.

Title: Submit support form empty / invalid email
Steps:
1. Submit with empty fields
2. Submit with invalid email
Expected result: Form not submitted; errors shown
Actual result: No validation: empty form and invalid email 'test@' both submit (email field is type='text').

Title: Newsletter signup with invalid email
Steps:
1. Enter invalid email in newsletter field
2. Submit
Expected result: Rejected with validation message
Actual result: As expected. Browser rejects 'abc'. (A valid email also does nothing, see BUG-005.)

Title: All navigation and footer links work
Steps: 1. Click every header and footer link on each page
Expected result: Every link opens the correct page; no 404s or dead '#' links
Actual result: No 404s. Footer links Terms of service, Privacy policy and Trademarks point to '#' and go nowhere.

Title: Home page carousel
Steps:
1. Watch carousel
2. Use its controls
Expected result: Slides change correctly; controls work; images not distorted
Actual result: As expected. Auto-advances every ~3.5 s; Previous and Next work; images not distorted (object-fit: cover).

Title: Mobile layout (phone width)
Steps:
1. Visit home, recipes, details, submit, login
2. Scroll each page
Expected result: No horizontal scrolling; text readable; buttons usable by touch
Actual result: As expected. No horizontal scrolling on home, recipes, details, submit and login (phone-width device view).

Title: Filter panel on mobile
Steps:
1. Open recipes page
2. Open filter panel
3. Close it
Expected result: Panel opens and closes; page scrolls normally after closing
Actual result: Panel opens, but has no close button on mobile (hidden by CSS). Only way out is Apply Filters.

Title: Cross-browser check
Steps: 1. Repeat SU-01, LI-01, SR-01 and RB-01 in a second browser
Expected result: Same behavior and layout in both browsers
Actual result: As expected.
